sections.content: Use todavía no with the pretérito perfecto to say that something has not happened or has not been done yet. Todavía no normally comes before the auxiliary: Todavía no he preparado la comida. It is useful when responding to an invitation and explaining that preparations are incomplete.

items.spanish: Todavía no he preparado la comida.
items.english: I have not prepared the food yet.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos comprado la comida.
items.english: We have not bought the food yet.

items.spanish: Todavía no he aceptado la invitación.
items.english: I have not accepted the invitation yet.

sections.content: Use ya for something completed and todavía no for something that has not happened yet.
